'''Vesla Three''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]]<ref name="Lost Suns 3" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Corosi sector/Legends|Corosi sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Mekhis]] tested one of her new [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] on the planet during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], ripping apart Vesla Three with gravity-manipulating technology.<ref name="Lost Suns 3" />
